approved_command_preview: Validate PR #385 issue #379 at fdb034659f222e135b4df3436d08ddab3371b946 in a separate worktree: write the exact grep pipeline to a temporary bash script, run that script, capture detail lines, run audit_generated_evidence.py --check, write concise readback summaries, and remove the worktree.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

function Get-DcoirExecEnvironmentValue {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Name)
    $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($Name, 'Process')
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) {
        $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($Name, 'Machine')
    }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) { throw "$Name is not set." }
    return $value
}

function Write-Utf8Lines {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path, [AllowNull()][string[]]$Lines)
    if ($null -eq $Lines) { $Lines = @() }
    $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($Path, [string[]]$Lines, $utf8)
}

$requestId = 'exec-20260713-pr385-issue379-validation-003'
$repo = Get-DcoirExecEnvironmentValue -Name 'DCOIR_REPO_ROOT'
$downloads = Get-DcoirExecEnvironmentValue -Name 'DCOIR_DOWNLOADS_DIR'
$headSha = 'fdb034659f222e135b4df3436d08ddab3371b946'
$branchName = 'codex/379-cross-cutting-sync'
$outDir = Join-Path $downloads $requestId
$reportDir = Join-Path $repo (Join-Path '.github/chatgpt_staging/status_reports/chatgpt-exec' $requestId)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir, $reportDir | Out-Null

$tempRoot = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($tempRoot)) { $tempRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath() }
$worktreeRoot = Join-Path $tempRoot ("worktree-$requestId")
$worktreeCreated = $false

$summary = [ordered]@{
    schema = 'dcoir.issue379.validation_readback.v1'
    request_id = $requestId
    pr_number = 385
    branch_name = $branchName
    expected_head_sha = $headSha
    actual_head_sha = $null
    started_utc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
    finished_utc = $null
    result = 'running'
    outside_dotgithub_file_count = 0
    outside_dotgithub_detail_line_count = 0
    outside_dotgithub_files = @()
    requires_followup_classification = $false
    checks = @()
}

function Add-ValidationCheck {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Name, [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Result, [string]$Notes = '')
    $script:summary['checks'] = @($script:summary['checks']) + [ordered]@{ name = $Name; result = $Result; notes = $Notes }
}

function Write-ValidationSummaryFiles {
    $json = $script:summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
    $json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $outDir 'issue379-validation-summary.json') -Encoding UTF8
    $json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'issue379-validation-summary.json') -Encoding UTF8
    $lines = @(
        '# Issue 379 validation summary', '',
        "- request_id: $($script:summary['request_id'])",
        "- result: $($script:summary['result'])",
        "- pr_number: $($script:summary['pr_number'])",
        "- branch_name: $($script:summary['branch_name'])",
        "- expected_head_sha: $($script:summary['expected_head_sha'])",
        "- actual_head_sha: $($script:summary['actual_head_sha'])",
        "- outside_dotgithub_file_count: $($script:summary['outside_dotgithub_file_count'])",
        "- outside_dotgithub_detail_line_count: $($script:summary['outside_dotgithub_detail_line_count'])",
        "- requires_followup_classification: $($script:summary['requires_followup_classification'])",
        '', '## Checks'
    )
    foreach ($check in @($script:summary['checks'])) { $lines += "- $($check.name): $($check.result) $($check.notes)" }
    $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reportDir 'issue379-validation-summary.md') -Encoding UTF8
}

try {
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktreeRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $worktreeRoot -Recurse -Force }

    $refSpec = '+refs/heads/{0}:refs/remotes/origin/{0}' -f $branchName
    & git -C $repo fetch --no-tags origin $refSpec
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git fetch failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

    & git -C $repo worktree add --detach $worktreeRoot $headSha
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git worktree add failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
    $worktreeCreated = $true

    $actualHead = (& git -C $worktreeRoot rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
    $summary['actual_head_sha'] = $actualHead
    if ($actualHead -ne $headSha) { throw "Worktree HEAD mismatch. Expected $headSha but got $actualHead." }
    Add-ValidationCheck -Name 'checkout_exact_head' -Result 'pass' -Notes $actualHead

    $grepPattern = '\bchatgpt_staging/\|\bops/requests\|\bops/tools\|\boperator_tools/\|project_sources/github_actions\|tools/chatgpt_apply_in\|tools/chatgpt_stage_out'
    $grepGlobs = @('*.yml', '*.py', '*.ps1', '*.md', '*.json')
    $grepRawPath = Join-Path $outDir 'issue379-git-grep-raw-files.txt'
    $grepOutsidePath = Join-Path $reportDir 'issue379-grep-files-outside-dotgithub.txt'
    $grepDetailPath = Join-Path $outDir 'issue379-grep-detail-outside-dotgithub.txt'
    $grepDetailReportPath = Join-Path $reportDir 'issue379-grep-detail-outside-dotgithub.txt'
    $exactGrepPath = Join-Path $outDir 'issue379-exact-grep-command-output.txt'
    $exactGrepScriptPath = Join-Path $worktreeRoot 'issue379-exact-grep.sh'
    $exactGrepScriptReportPath = Join-Path $reportDir 'issue379-exact-grep-command.sh'

    $grepFileArgs = @('-C', $worktreeRoot, 'grep', '-ln', $grepPattern, '--') + $grepGlobs
    $grepFileOutput = @(& git @grepFileArgs 2>&1)
    $grepFileExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Write-Utf8Lines -Path $grepRawPath -Lines @($grepFileOutput | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
    if ($grepFileExit -gt 1) { throw "issue #379 git grep file-list command failed with exit code $grepFileExit." }
    $outsideFiles = @($grepFileOutput | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Where-Object { $_ -and ($_ -notmatch '^\.github/') } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    Write-Utf8Lines -Path $grepOutsidePath -Lines @($outsideFiles)

    if (-not (Get-Command bash -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'bash is not available on the runner, so the exact issue #379 grep pipeline cannot be executed.' }
    $exactGrepScript = @'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
git grep -ln "\bchatgpt_staging/\|\bops/requests\|\bops/tools\|\boperator_tools/\|project_sources/github_actions\|tools/chatgpt_apply_in\|tools/chatgpt_stage_out" -- '*.yml' '*.py' '*.ps1' '*.md' '*.json' | grep -v '^\.github/'
'@
    $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exactGrepScriptPath, (($exactGrepScript.TrimStart() -replace "`r`n", "`n") + "`n"), $utf8)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($exactGrepScriptReportPath, (($exactGrepScript.TrimStart() -replace "`r`n", "`n") + "`n"), $utf8)
    Push-Location $worktreeRoot
    try {
        $oldEap = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        try {
            $exactGrepOutput = @(& bash ./issue379-exact-grep.sh 2>&1)
            $exactGrepExit = $LASTEXITCODE
        }
        finally { $ErrorActionPreference = $oldEap }
    }
    finally { Pop-Location }
    $exactGrepLines = @($exactGrepOutput | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' })
    Write-Utf8Lines -Path $exactGrepPath -Lines @($exactGrepLines)
    if ($exactGrepExit -ne 0 -and $exactGrepExit -ne 1) { throw "exact issue #379 grep pipeline failed with exit code $exactGrepExit." }
    $grepDiff = @(Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $outsideFiles -DifferenceObject @($exactGrepLines | Sort-Object -Unique))
    if ($grepDiff.Count -ne 0) { throw 'Exact issue #379 grep output differs from raw git grep outside-.github classification.' }
    Add-ValidationCheck -Name 'issue379_exact_grep_pipeline' -Result 'pass' -Notes ("exit_code={0}; outside_dotgithub_file_count={1}" -f $exactGrepExit, $outsideFiles.Count)

    $grepDetailArgs = @('-C', $worktreeRoot, 'grep', '-n', $grepPattern, '--') + $grepGlobs
    $grepDetailOutput = @(& git @grepDetailArgs 2>&1)
    $grepDetailExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($grepDetailExit -gt 1) {
        Write-Utf8Lines -Path $grepDetailPath -Lines @($grepDetailOutput | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ })
        throw "issue #379 git grep detail command failed with exit code $grepDetailExit."
    }
    $outsideDetails = @($grepDetailOutput | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ } | Where-Object { $_ -and ($_ -notmatch '^\.github/') })
    Write-Utf8Lines -Path $grepDetailPath -Lines @($outsideDetails)
    Write-Utf8Lines -Path $grepDetailReportPath -Lines @($outsideDetails)
    Add-ValidationCheck -Name 'issue379_grep_detail_capture' -Result 'pass' -Notes ("outside_dotgithub_detail_line_count={0}" -f $outsideDetails.Count)

    $summary['outside_dotgithub_file_count'] = $outsideFiles.Count
    $summary['outside_dotgithub_detail_line_count'] = $outsideDetails.Count
    $summary['outside_dotgithub_files'] = @($outsideFiles)
    $summary['requires_followup_classification'] = ($outsideFiles.Count -gt 0)

    $auditStdout = Join-Path $outDir 'audit-generated-evidence.stdout.txt'
    $auditStderr = Join-Path $outDir 'audit-generated-evidence.stderr.txt'
    & python (Join-Path $worktreeRoot '.github/dcoir_review/scripts/audit_generated_evidence.py') --repo-root $worktreeRoot --check > $auditStdout 2> $auditStderr
    $auditExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    if ($auditExit -ne 0) {
        Add-ValidationCheck -Name 'audit_generated_evidence_check' -Result 'failed' -Notes "exit_code=$auditExit"
        throw "audit_generated_evidence.py --check failed with exit code $auditExit."
    }
    Add-ValidationCheck -Name 'audit_generated_evidence_check' -Result 'pass' -Notes 'exit_code=0'
    $summary['result'] = 'success'
}
catch {
    $summary['result'] = 'failure'
    $summary['error'] = ($_ | Out-String).Trim()
    throw
}
finally {
    $summary['finished_utc'] = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')
    Write-ValidationSummaryFiles
    if ($worktreeCreated -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktreeRoot)) {
        & git -C $repo worktree remove --force $worktreeRoot 2>$null
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktreeRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $worktreeRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
    }
}
